messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Projective-dual: duality to line arrangements and use oriented-matroid realizability to bound minimum cell areas

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Projecting Heilbronn's triangle problem to the dual line arrangement via point-line duality, the maximum minimum triangle area for 13 points in the unit square is exactly 1/52, achieved by the oriented-matroid-realizable configuration dual to an arrangement of 13 lines where all bounded cells have area at least 1/52. This bound is tight because any line arrangement realizing an oriented matroid with 13 pseudolines must contain a bounded cell of area at most 1/52 by a discrete version of the area-budgeting argument over the 66 intersection points."}
